changelog: TV remote: keep settings focus inside the open page, restore the previous selection on Back, and prevent native player controls from consuming settings navigation.
Keyboard: repaired callback stacking, Center/Enter/Numpad Enter activation, held-key duplicates and cancellation; restored lowercase and Shift behavior.
Fast and smooth scrolling: remove owned handles, listeners and animations on refresh, disable or detach without replacing native touch/fling handlers.
Hide Search History now survives native query updates and restores the native visibility when disabled. Scene bookmarks use the current native video title.
ATTENTION: Update through dcext or the CS3M Updater, then fully restart CloudStream.
message: v741 - TV remote navigation and active feature repairs
